subject.why: The milk bottle is instantly recognisable, full of milk, featuring the requested red-and-white cap and red checked ribbon around the neck.

category.why: The bottle floats at a pleasant tilt without any ground or table, set against a saturated gradient background with concentric rings.

clean.why: There are no UI elements, text, borders, watermarks, or characters.

framing.why: The bottle is well-centred with comfortable margins on all sides and nothing is cropped.

colour.why: The palette is saturated and vivid, and the white milk bottle with red accents stands out crisply against the bright purple background.

detail.why: The shapes are bold and clean without realistic micro-textures, scratches, or unnecessary extra props.

style.why: The 3D render features chunky volumes, smooth bevels, and a clean satin finish matching the reference game art.
